name: singapore-compliance-2026
display_name: Singapore Compliance 2026 — MAS Notice 626 (revised), FSMA DTSP, PSA, PDPA
description: Structured knowledge graph for the Singapore regulatory wave of 2024-2026: MAS Notice 626 amendments effective 30 June 2025 (mandatory PF risk assessment + STR streamlining + updated PEP + BO treatment), the FSMA 2022 Part 9 Digital Token Service Provider framework live 30 June 2025 (closing the Singapore-domiciled outbound-only VASP loophole), Payment Services Act amendments (DPT protections, April 2024), the SFA + Banking Act + Insurance Act + FAA as the sectoral foundation, PDPA (with PDPC AI Model Governance + Children's Data Guidelines), MAS TRM + BCM + Outsourcing Guidelines, SGX Sustainability Reporting (IFRS S1/S2 phased), Variable Capital Companies Act, Workplace Fairness Act 2025, plus key cross-cutting authorities (MAS / STRO / PDPC / ACRA / CPIB / CCCS / IRAS / AGC).
